seo.title: H & L Holiday Lighting | Carterville, IL
seo.description: Custom Christmas light design and professional installation for homes and businesses across Southern Illinois.

services.text04: Choose a look for your roofline, trees, or landscape. H & L offers installation, maintenance, takedown, and storage services.

estimate.text04: Tell us about your property, preferred lighting style, and timing so we can discuss your estimate.

work.text04: A look at H & L projects, from classic warm white to joyful full-color displays.

editorial_split.text06: Plan beyond installation day. H & L offers services for your display during the holidays and after the season ends.

faq.text02: Start with your property details and the look you have in mind.
faq.text04: Share your property size, the rooflines or trees you want lit, access details, and your preferred display style. These details help H & L understand the scope of your project and discuss pricing with you.
faq.text05: When should I request an installation?
faq.text06: Send your inquiry once you know your preferred dates. Include when you would like your display ready; H & L can confirm current availability before you book. Submitting an inquiry does not reserve an installation date.
faq.text07: Are lights supplied, and what is included?
faq.text08: Before booking, confirm who supplies and owns the lights, which maintenance visits are covered, and the arrangements for takedown and storage. The listed services do not specify what is included in your individual estimate.
